verdict.rationale: Bugbot is an AI code-review agent, so plugging in MCP servers as a client is a fair axis to ask about. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions MCP or connecting external tool servers to Bugbot. The documented configuration covers only BUGBOT.md rules, automations, effort levels and repository integrations, none of which is MCP tool plug-in support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
